meta.title: CDP Browser Control
meta.description: Drive Chrome or Edge over the Chrome DevTools Protocol: open pages, read the screen as images, click and type, and collect console errors and uncaught exceptions.

tools.launch: Start a controlled Chrome or Edge instance, or attach to one that already exposes a DevTools port.
tools.pages: List, open, select, or close browser pages.
tools.navigate: Navigate the current page and wait for it to settle.
tools.screenshot: Capture what the browser currently shows and return it as an image.
tools.snapshot: List the interactive elements of the page with stable refs, roles, and click coordinates.
tools.console: Read collected console messages, uncaught exceptions, and failed requests.
tools.click: Click an element by ref or CSS selector, or click page coordinates.
tools.type: Focus an element and type text, optionally submitting it.
tools.evaluate: Evaluate JavaScript in the page and return the value.
tools.openDsh: Open this Harness web GUI in the controlled browser with a valid access token.
tools.close: Close the controlled browser and drop its DevTools connection and collected errors.
tools.read: Read the readable text of the page or one element as plain text, without an image.

panel.title: Browser panel
panel.description: Live screen, pages, and recent errors of the browser this Session controls.
